title: Riftweave cRPG Ruleset Root Schema
description: Root schema referencing all rule data types. Each data file in the ruleset should reference its specific schema via $schema.

ability.description: Core attributes (1-10 scale): Strength, Perception, Endurance, Intelligence, Willpower, Agility, Charisma, Luck

diceExpression.description: Polyhedral dice notation used for damage and similar rolls, e.g. 1d8, 2d6+3. Resolution (skill/attack checks) uses d100 roll-under, not this.

percentile.description: A d100 roll-under value (skill rating, chance, or resistance), normally 0-100 but allowed above 100 for buffed/legendary values.

color.description: Color magic school. The governing skill is <color>_magic.

phase.description: Wuxing (五行) five-phase tag. Governs how an effect INTERACTS with other effects via the generating/overcoming/insulting/weakening cycles (see data/wuxing). Orthogonal to color: color picks the governing <color>_magic skill, phase picks the elemental relationship. Omit for non-elemental effects, which do not participate in the cycles.

qualityGrade.description: Crafting quality ladder, listed lowest to highest (common is the baseline). Shared vocabulary reused across crafting conventions (gems, and future components).

entryId.description: Stable numeric primary identifier for an entry within a collection (effects, skills, features/perks, races, materials, ingredients, equipment, spells, monsters, backgrounds, etc.). Used for all cross-references in the data.

appliedEffect.description: An instance of an effect drawn from the effect registry (data/effects), with its applied magnitude and duration. Shared by spells, consumables, ingredients, and enchantments. Use 'parameter' for generic effects (e.g. fortify_skill with a specific skill id, fortify_attribute with an ability, restore_resource with 'health'/'stamina'/'mana', resist with 'fire'/'poison'/'undead'/'magic'/'physical', cure with a condition, summon with a type, allergy with a material id).

effect.description: Effect id (numeric) from the effect registry (data/effects)

magnitude.description: Effect strength; interpreted per the effect's magnitudeUnit

duration.description: Duration in seconds; 0 or omitted means instantaneous

target.description: Delivery shape (used by spells); omit for consumables/ingredients, which apply to the user

radius.description: Area radius in meters when target is 'area'

parameter.description: For generic parameterized effects (fortify_skill, fortify_attribute, restore_resource, resist, cure, summon, phobia, allergy, etc.), specifies the subject. Use the numeric entryId when it references another collection's primary id (e.g. a skill for fortify_skill, a material for allergy). Use string for vocabulary values (e.g. 'health', 'fire', 'all', ability codes, creature categories).

durationType.description: For fortify effects (especially on skills/attributes): 'unlimited' effects are normally stackable (magnitudes add). 'temporal' effects of the same type (same effect id + parameter) override each other, taking the highest magnitude as the effective value (and usually the longest duration).

creatureCategory.description: Standard categories used for phobias, creature-specific effects, and interactions (e.g. in generic 'phobia' effects). Common values: undead, beast, construct, humanoid, dragon, spirit, aberration, plant, ooze. Material ids for 'allergy' effects come from materials/core.json. These are string cross-references and not strictly schema-enforced.
